tests.title: Export by Scenes — Cross-Scene Fix
steps: Create 2 scenes, each with at least 1 mesh object
Open Batch Export, set scope to 'Scenes'
Set output dir, format to FBX, click OK
expected: One .fbx file per scene, named after the scene
Both scenes are exported (not just the active one)
Each file contains the meshes from that scene
Info area shows correct succeeded count (2)
After export, the active scene is restored to Scene 1

tests.title: Export All Objects — Cross-Scene Fix
steps: Create 2 scenes: Scene 1 with 3 mesh objects, Scene 2 with 2 mesh objects
Open Batch Export, set scope to 'All Objects'
Set output dir, format to FBX, click OK
expected: Five individual .fbx files created (one per mesh across both scenes)
No duplicate files for objects that appear in multiple scenes
After export, the active scene is restored to Scene 1

tests.title: Invalid Output Path — Clean Error
steps: Set output directory to a non-existent drive (e.g. 'Z:\nonexistent\path')
Select an object and attempt to export
expected: Export fails gracefully with a single clean error line
Error message includes 'drive or root' and 'does not exist'
No chained traceback (no 'During handling of the above exception' spam)
Report shows 0 succeeded, 1 failed with error details

tests.title: Export at Origin — No Unwanted Directory Creation
steps: Set output to a path on a non-existent drive (e.g. 'Z:\some\deep\path')
expected: Export fails with a clean error about the drive not existing
No directories are created on the non-existent drive
The object's location is restored to (5, 10, 3) even after failure
On a valid drive, subdirectories ARE created as expected (this is normal behaviour)
